payload.name: Amplitude EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Amplitude workspace to search charts and dashboards, query metrics and experiment results, explore events and properties, and create or update charts, dashboards, and alerts — without leaving the conversation. Amplitude is the product intelligence platform teams use to understand user behavior, measure impact, and decide what to build next.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Amplitude 工作区，无需离开对话，即可搜索图表和仪表板、查询指标和实验结果、探索事件和属性，以及创建或更新图表、仪表板和警报。Amplitude 是团队用于理解用户行为、衡量影响并决定下一步构建什么的产品智能平台。

payload.name: Sixtyfour Intelligence
payload.description: 用于情报分析的 AI 智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Deploy AI agents that investigate people and companies, resolve identities, map relationships, and surface risk signals — all through a single API.
payload.longDescription: 通过单一 API 部署 AI 智能体，用于调查个人和公司、确认身份、绘制关系网络并发现风险信号。

payload.name: Atlan
payload.description: 为 AI 提供企业上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect ChatGPT to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, so every question you ask ChatGPT is grounded in trusted organisational context.
payload.longDescription: Atlan 是企业 AI 的上下文层。将 ChatGPT 连接至组织的上下文库，获取 AI 智能体准确回答所需的知识、数据和语义。使用 Atlan 的智能体技能搜索和发现企业上下文、追踪端到端数据血缘、访问受治理的数据定义和术语表、执行 SQL、维护元数据图谱，以及确保数据质量，让你向 ChatGPT 提出的每个问题都以可信的组织上下文为依据。

payload.name: JoomPulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: JoomPulse gives you instant access to MercadoLivre Brazil's marketplace data through natural language queries. Analyze product listings, categories, sellers, pricing trends, reviews, and keywords — all powered by a structured data warehouse. Whether you're doing competitive research, category analysis, or tracking listing performance, JoomPulse translates your questions into precise data insights without writing a single line of SQL. Built for e-commerce teams and analysts who need fast, reliable answers from Brazil's largest online marketplace.
payload.longDescription: JoomPulse 通过自然语言即时访问 MercadoLivre 巴西市场数据。分析商品列表、类别、卖家、价格趋势、评价和关键词，所有结果来自结构化数据仓库。适合竞争研究、类别分析和挂牌表现跟踪，无需编写 SQL。

payload.name: ChartMogul
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChartMogul’s MCP server gives AI assistants secure access to your subscription analytics and customer data. Analyze MRR, ARR, churn, retention, cohorts, subscriptions, revenue trends, and customer activity using natural language. Investigate business performance, identify growth opportunities, uncover churn drivers, explore customer relationships, and answer complex questions about your SaaS business. Built for founders and go-to-market, product, and finance teams, it turns ChartMogul data into actionable insights and faster decisions.
payload.longDescription: ChartMogul 的 MCP 服务器让 AI 助手安全访问您的订阅分析和客户数据。使用自然语言分析 MRR、ARR、流失、留存、群组、订阅、收入趋势和客户活动。调查业务表现、发现增长机会、找出流失驱动因素、探索客户关系，并回答有关 SaaS 业务的复杂问题。它面向创始人以及市场进入、产品和财务团队，将 ChartMogul 数据转化为可执行洞察和更快决策。

payload.name: Deepnote
payload.description: 让智能体运行数据工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your Deepnote workspace into Codex. Search your workspace, trigger analytical workflows across 60+ data connectors, and use the output in Codex. No SQL, R, or Python knowledge required with the help of OpenAI models.

With Deepnote MCP, you can:

- Search across your projects, notebooks, and integrations
- Run an end-to-end notebook
- Pull the latest result from the notebook runs
- See scheduled runs in the workspace

All this while respecting your Deepnote workspace’s permissions. Note: this MCP requires an active Deepnote account and a Deepnote API token (https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api).
payload.longDescription:
将 Deepnote 工作区引入 Codex。搜索工作区、通过 60+ 个数据连接器触发分析工作流，并在 Codex 中使用输出结果。在 OpenAI 模型的帮助下，无需掌握 SQL、R 或 Python。

借助 Deepnote MCP，你可以：

- 搜索项目、笔记本和集成
- 运行端到端笔记本
- 获取笔记本运行产生的最新结果
- 查看工作区中的计划运行

所有这些操作都会遵循你的 Deepnote 工作区权限。注意：此 MCP 需要有效的 Deepnote 账户和 Deepnote API 令牌 (https://deepnote.com/docs/deepnote-api)。

payload.name: InsightfulPipe
payload.description: 通过InsightfulPipe工作区连接Google Ads、Meta和TikTok
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to 50 marketing, advertising, analytics, SEO, social media, e-commerce, database, and productivity platforms through one InsightfulPipe workspace. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, compare performance across channels, create reports, and perform supported actions when your connection allows it.

Advertising and competitive research: Analyze campaigns, spend, conversions, audiences, and creatives across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, X Ads, and OpenAI Ads. Research competitors with supported public advertising libraries.

Analytics, SEO, and site health: Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, YouTube Analytics, DataForSEO, PageSpeed Insights, website crawling, screenshots, and Google Tag Manager.

Social media, content, and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, WordPress, and Telegram sources. Upload media and schedule, publish, cancel, or reschedule supported social posts across connected accounts.

E-commerce, email, and app research: Explore Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp data. Research apps, developers, and reviews from the Apple App Store and Google Play.

Business data and custom sources: Query BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server according to each connection's permissions. Work with Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, and workspace-defined REST APIs based on OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

InsightfulPipe can combine data that normally lives in separate services. For example, compare ad spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue, or combine search performance with technical SEO findings to prioritize optimizations.

Read and write capabilities are separated. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts. Write actions require the necessary permissions and confirmation for destructive or public-facing changes. Platform-specific safety controls also apply.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, fields, metrics, and actions depend on the user's connected services, plan, and granted permissions.
payload.longDescription:
通过一个InsightfulPipe工作区连接50个营销、广告、分析、SEO、社交媒体、电商、数据库和生产力平台。
用自然语言提问，获取实时数据，跨渠道对比表现，生成报告，并在连接允许的情况下执行支持的操作。

广告与竞品研究：分析Google Ads、Meta广告、微软广告、领英广告、TikTok广告、Pinterest广告、Snapchat广告、X广告和OpenAI广告中的广告活动、支出、转化率、受众群体和创意内容。
通过支持的公开广告库研究竞争对手。

分析、SEO与网站健康度：使用Google Analytics 4、Google搜索控制台、必应网站管理员工具、微软清晰度、CallRail、YouTube分析、DataForSEO、页面速度洞察、网站爬取、截图和Google标签管理器。

社交媒体、内容与日程安排：分析连接的Instagram、Facebook页面、领英页面、TikTok、Pinterest、YouTube、Google商业资料、WordPress和Telegram来源。
跨连接账户上传媒体并安排、发布、取消或重新安排支持的社交媒体帖子。

电商、邮件与应用研究：探索Shopify、WooCommerce、Magento、Google商家中心、Klaviyo和Mailchimp数据。
从苹果应用商店和Google Play研究应用、开发者和评价。

业务数据与自定义数据源：根据每个连接的权限查询BigQuery、PostgreSQL、MySQL和SQL Server。
基于OpenAPI 3.x规范，使用Google表格、Airtable、Notion、Slack和工作区定义的REST API进行操作。

InsightfulPipe可以整合通常存在于独立服务中的数据。
例如将广告支出与网站会话、转化率、订单和收入对比，或结合搜索表现与技术SEO分析结果以优先优化方向。

读取和写入功能相互分离。只读工具不会修改已连接的账户。写入操作需要必要的权限，并且对破坏性或面向公众的更改需要确认。平台特定的安全控制措施同样适用。

需要拥有至少一个授权连接的InsightfulPipe账户。可用的平台、字段、指标和操作取决于用户的已连接服务、计划及所授予的权限。

payload.name: Polar Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn ChatGPT into your data analyst. Ask questions about your Shopify store, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other channels in plain language. Get answers on ROAS, CAC, top-performing SKUs, profit margins, and more, all pulled from Polar’s semantic layer for accuracy. Supports multi-store setups and works with major ecommerce integrations, including TikTok Ads and Klaviyo.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 变成您的数据分析师。用日常语言询问 Shopify 商店、Meta Ads、Google Ads 和其他渠道的数据。获取 ROAS、CAC、表现最佳的 SKU、利润率等信息，所有数据均来自 Polar 语义层，以确保准确性。支持多店铺设置，并兼容 TikTok Ads 和 Klaviyo 等主流电商集成。

payload.name: Tenzo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tenzo connects ChatGPT to your restaurant data. Ask questions in plain English about sales, labour, covers, average check, item mix, customer reviews and manager logs across all your locations. The app reads the same metrics and dimensions you already see in your Tenzo dashboard, respects your existing user permissions and business access, and can save useful queries back as cards and dashboards in your Tenzo account.
payload.longDescription: Tenzo 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的餐厅数据。你可以用通俗的英语询问所有门店的销售额、人工、客流人数、平均消费、商品组合、顾客评价和经理日志。应用读取你在 Tenzo 仪表板中已能看到的相同指标和维度，遵循你现有的用户权限和业务访问权限，并可将有用的查询保存为卡片和仪表板，写回你的 Tenzo 账户。

payload.name: Tango MCP
payload.description: 统一的政府承包数据 MCP
payload.summaryOriginal: A unified MCP for govcon data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tango provides a unified API and MCP for federal procurement data. Tango is built by govcon experts and software developers who understand the pain of stitching together multiple government data sources. Designed specifically for public-sector builders and for AI-ready data consumers.
payload.longDescription: Tango 为联邦采购数据提供统一 API 和 MCP。Tango 由政府承包领域的专家和软件开发人员打造，他们了解整合多个政府数据源所带来的困难。专为公共部门的开发者和需要适配 AI 的数据使用者设计。

payload.name: Adobe CJA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics helps authorized users discover data views, dimensions, metrics, segments, date ranges, projects, and audiences; run ranked CJA reports; inspect component definitions; and create or update reusable CJA components and Workspace projects through ChatGPT. It requires Adobe IMS OAuth and Customer Journey Analytics product access, and tool calls use the signed-in user's IMS organization, sandbox or product context, and CJA permissions.
payload.longDescription: Adobe Customer Journey Analytics 帮助获授权的用户通过 ChatGPT 查找数据视图、维度、指标、细分群体、日期范围、项目和受众；运行排名式CJA报告；检查组件定义；以及创建或更新可复用的CJA组件和 Workspace 项目。它需要 Adobe IMS OAuth 及 Customer Journey Analytics 产品访问权限，工具调用会使用已登录用户的IMS组织、沙盒或产品上下文，以及CJA权限。

payload.name: Catchr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Catchr helps marketers and agencies work with their marketing data directly in ChatGPT. 
Ask questions about campaign performance, compare results across connected sources, and turn raw metrics into clear reporting insights for clients and teams.
payload.longDescription: Catchr 帮助营销人员和代理机构直接在 ChatGPT 中处理营销数据。询问营销活动表现、比较已连接来源的结果，并将原始指标转化为面向客户和团队的清晰报告洞察。

payload.name: Lytical
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lytical automatically captures website activity and turns it into useful insights so you can understand traffic, behavior, and trends without digging through analytics reports. It helps you quickly answer questions like what changed, why it changed, and what to do next.
payload.longDescription: Lytical 会自动采集网站活动并将其转化为实用洞察，帮助你了解流量、用户行为和趋势，无需费力翻查分析报告。它能帮你快速回答诸如发生了什么变化、变化原因以及接下来该做什么等问题。

payload.name: Syncly Social
payload.description: 追踪社交媒体上的品牌提及
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Syncly's social intelligence into ChatGPT and Codex. Search brand mentions across social, including video. Track sentiment and mention volume over time, surface top creators, keywords, and trends, and rank posts by performance to see what is working.
payload.longDescription: 将 Syncly 的社交媒体洞察引入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。搜索社交平台上的品牌提及，包括视频内容。追踪情绪倾向和提及量的变化，发现热门创作者、关键词和趋势，并按表现为帖子排名，以了解哪些内容有效。

payload.name: Landstack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Landstack MCP connects your AI model directly to UK land, planning and development data. Search and analyse planning applications, read planning documents, review local and neighbourhood plans, explore site allocations and land availability assessments, and look up title ownership data — all without leaving your AI workflow. 

Whether you're evaluating a single site or working through hundreds, Landstack gives your model the context it needs to answer detailed questions about planning history, policy constraints and land ownership across England, Wales and Scotland.
payload.longDescription:
Landstack MCP 可将 AI 模型直接连接到英国土地、规划和开发数据。搜索规划申请、阅读规划文件、审阅地方及社区规划、查看地块分配和土地可用性评估，并查询产权所有权数据——全程无需离开 AI 工作流。

无论是评估单个地块，还是处理数百个地块，Landstack 都能为模型提供所需背景信息，以便回答有关英格兰、威尔士和苏格兰规划历史、政策限制及土地所有权的详细问题。

payload.name: Property Hazard MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hazard lookup for any US address — flood, wildfire, earthquake, and coastal-storm exposure in a single call, using public government data (Census, FEMA, USGS). No API key required.
payload.longDescription: 只需一次调用，即可查询美国任意地址面临的危险——包括洪水、野火、地震和沿海风暴暴露风险；数据来自 Census、FEMA 和 USGS 等政府公开数据源。无需 API 密钥。

payload.name: Kindora
payload.description: 社会公益领域资助方研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kindora gives nonprofits and researchers direct access to the philanthropic funding landscape. Search grantmakers by name, cause area, geography, size, or classification; review IRS 990 financial summaries and grant histories; find open foundation and government grant opportunities; analyze giving patterns; and browse philanthropy jobs. Results come from public filings, public funder websites, and Kindora's curated funder corpus. The submitted tools are free, read-only, and require no Kindora account.
payload.longDescription: Kindora 为非营利组织和研究人员直接提供慈善资助领域信息。按名称、事业领域、地理位置、规模或分类搜索资助机构；查看 IRS 990 财务摘要和资助历史；查找开放申请的基金会和政府资助机会；分析捐赠模式；并浏览慈善领域职位。结果来自公开申报资料、资助方官网和 Kindora 精选的资助方语料库。提交的工具免费、只读，无需 Kindora 账户。

payload.name: Improvado AI Agent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Improvado AI Agent helps users work with Improvado workspaces through ChatGPT: inspect workspaces, data sources, connections, extracts, loads, documents, dashboards, recipes, and Discovery API workflows; switch workspace context; query data; and create or update private workspace resources.
payload.longDescription: Improvado AI Agent 可帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 使用 Improvado 工作区：检查工作区、数据源、连接、提取、加载、文档、仪表板、配方和 Discovery API 工作流；切换工作区上下文；查询数据；以及创建或更新工作区私有资源。

payload.name: Reverse Contact
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Reverse Contact turns an email address, a name, or a LinkedIn URL into a professional profile. Ask who is behind an email address, summarise a person and the company they work for, or search people and companies by job title, industry, headcount and location.

Cached lookups return instantly. Live tools start a fresh collection and run asynchronously, returning a task you poll until it completes. Every call costs credits from your Reverse Contact workspace, and checking your balance is free.

You need a Reverse Contact account to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
Reverse Contact 可将电子邮件地址、姓名或 LinkedIn URL 转换为职业档案。你可以询问某个电子邮件地址背后的人是谁、总结某个人及其任职公司，或按职位名称、行业、员工人数和地点搜索个人及公司。

缓存查询会即时返回结果。实时工具会启动新的数据收集并异步运行，返回一个任务供你轮询，直到任务完成。每次调用都会消耗 Reverse Contact 工作区的额度，查询余额免费。

使用此插件需要 Reverse Contact 账户。

payload.name: Fr8Labs Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask your freight-forwarding data anything — shipments, revenue, costs, margins, P&L, and AR/AP ageing — in plain language, and turn answers into charts, dashboards, and scheduled email reports, straight from your Fr8Labs FMS. payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:

* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

将 Subtext 链接交给智能体，无论该链接来自其已连接的位置——Sentry 问题、Linear 工单、支持对话还是 PR——它都会使用 Agentic Session Review 跳到相关时刻、检查屏幕截图和无障碍树、对比 DOM 状态，并读取控制台和网络活动以找出根本原因。随后它会提交修复，或将发现交给你。你只需审核答案，无需查看回放。

* **可直接调用的会话工具**：打开会话、跳转到某个时刻、检查并比较状态——专为智能体高效遍历密集会话数据而设计，比让通用智能体处理原始回放所需的 token 更少。

payload.name: Keenable SELECT
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.
payload.longDescription:
Keenable SELECT 只需一次查询即可回答研究问题，无需逐页阅读十个网页。

普通网页搜索会把链接列表交给模型，阅读、提取和去重工作都由模型完成。SELECT 则在搜索过程中处理这些工作。模型以 DuckDB 方言编写一条只读 SQL 语句；服务器并行执行搜索、获取网页、通过逐行模型调用提取查询所需字段、删除重复项，并返回表格。

一次查询可覆盖 一千多个页面，并可用普通 SQL 筛选和分组结果，无需额外付费。返回的是表格，而不是大段网页文字，因此答案能够基于远超上下文容量的来源。

每项结果集都会保存 30 天，因此你可以针对相同页面提出后续问题，无需再次搜索。完成的表格可以发布为单个 HTML 报告，包含图表，并生成可分享的链接。

适用于跨许多来源进行调查、比较或排名。它不适合快速查看单个页面：一次查询需要几秒到几分钟，因为它确实会执行搜索、获取和阅读。

连接一次 Keenable 账户即可启用。搜索和获取页面的费用会计入该账户。

Coverage is fully developed for Luxembourg, Belgium, Spain and the European Union, alongside partial coverage of France and international law. Collections are complete rather than sampled, consolidated rather than scattered, and tracked for in-force status document by document.

payload.name: Muffed
payload.description: 查询经核实的 NFL 统计数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.
payload.longDescription:
Muffed 使用经过核实的数据回答 NFL 问题。每个数字都来自基于 nflverse 逐回合数据、NFL Next Gen Stats 和 FTN 记录数据构建的受控面板；每个回答都会附上自己的来源、核实日期，以及数据许可要求的出处说明。

询问数据表明 NFL 当前真实情况如何，查询球员或球队的赛季数据，获取排行榜，用通俗语言了解 EPA 或 CPOE 等高级指标，并排比较两名球员，或核查你在其他地方看到的统计数据——如果数据不一致，Muffed 会告诉你真实数值。你还可以通过 id 连接 Sleeper 联赛，获取其中球员经核实的背景信息。

Muffed 不提供预测、首发／替补或阵容建议、选秀评分、作为建议的排名或推荐选项，也不提供投注盘口或赔率。此服务器上的任何工具都无法生成这些内容：它没有预测模型，也没有提供建议性排名的界面。

每个回答都会标明自身范围。引用会准确指出涵盖哪些数据，并声明其范围不包括从数据推导出的分析。按请求计算而非来自预先核实面板的数据，会标记为 `computed_not_verified`，并附上实际执行的方法和样本数量。如果 Muffed 没有用户请求的数据，会明确说明这一点、指出已有数据覆盖范围，并拒绝为填补空缺的内容提供出处归属。调用此服务器的助手可以在返回数据的基础上添加自己的评论、比较或建议；这些评论属于助手自身，并不在 Muffed 核实或注明来源的范围内。

免费、只读、无需账户。梦幻橄榄球得分使用 half-PPR，这是最常见的单一重选联盟默认规则；每当该规则出现时都会注明。

payload.name: Alation
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Alation brings trusted enterprise data context into ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to Alation’s enterprise data catalog, governance, and trusted business context so users can discover, understand, and use data with confidence.

The Alation Intelligence Operating System (AIOS) helps AI ground responses in trusted enterprise context, including catalog metadata, governance policies, semantic definitions, lineage, data quality, and documentation. The app is designed for enterprise teams that need AI-led data discovery without losing trust, context, or governance.
payload.longDescription:
Alation将可信的企业数据上下文带入ChatGPT。

将ChatGPT连接到Alation的企业数据目录、治理体系和可信业务上下文，让用户能够放心地发现、理解和使用数据。

Alation Intelligence Operating System（AIOS）帮助AI以可信的企业上下文作为回答依据，包括目录元数据、治理政策、语义定义、数据血缘、数据质量和文档。该应用专为需要AI引导的数据发现，同时保持信任、上下文和治理的企业团队设计。

payload.name: WisdomAI
payload.description: 基于你治理的数据提供答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.

Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.

WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.

Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.

Use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"
payload.longDescription:
WisdomAI 是 ChatGPT 内面向企业的数据处理框架，专为需要确定、可追溯且一致答案的复杂分析问题而设计。

连接器提供访问能力。目录和语义层提供定义。WisdomAI 框架在运行时结合二者，为每个问题选择合适上下文，执行针对提问者的行级和列级安全控制，针对底层平台优化执行，验证结果并修复失败的查询。

WisdomAI 会从文档、查询日志、目录、语义层、dbt 和 BI 元数据中持续学习，不断强化业务上下文，主动识别上下文不足之处，并将建议的更改提交专家审核和版本管理。修正内容会成为受治理的组织知识，而非埋没在个人对话中的一次性修补。

WisdomAI 适用于各种数据平台、数据源和部署环境，包括完全本地部署，以处理不得离开环境的受监管数据。框架、上下文和查询执行均保留在防火墙内；只有答案会传出。

每个答案都以受治理的定义、企业数据和可见来源为依据，可信到足以用于业务决策。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 WisdomAI 可以：
- 查询受治理的业务数据：“EMEA 第三季度净收入与计划相比如何？”
- 沿着同一分析继续追问：“按细分市场拆解，并显示最近 4 个季度的数据。”
- 端到端调查开放式问题：“上季度 EMEA 未达计划，是什么原因？哪些细分市场和客户变动最大？进入第四季度后应关注什么？”
- 追溯答案所依据的定义和来源：“使用了哪种净收入定义？数据来自哪里？”
- 查看自己可用的数据：“我可以访问哪些数据？财务有哪些已定义指标？”

payload.name: PowerDMARC
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

payload.name: Collecte MTL
payload.description: 查询蒙特利尔垃圾收集日
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no personal information: an address is used only to look up its collection sector.
payload.longDescription:
Collecte MTL 会告诉你蒙特利尔岛上任何地点的垃圾收集时间。输入地址，即可获取各种类别的收集安排——垃圾、回收物、厨余和有机垃圾、绿色垃圾以及大件物品——包括该具体片区下一次收集日期。

它还可以指引你前往最近的 écocentres（投放中心），处理不提供路边收集的材料，并显示你所在行政区的废弃物回收和分流率。

数据直接来自蒙特利尔市官方开放数据（Secteurs Info-collectes），大约每月更新一次。Collecte MTL 是免费的独立工具，与蒙特利尔市无隶属关系，也不存储个人信息：地址仅用于查询所属收集片区。
